Try itWork one \(s(t)\): find its numbers
  1. Start, \(t = 0\):
    • \(s(0) = b_{0}\), \(\dot{s}(0) = b_{1}\), \(\ddot{s}(0) = 2b_{2}\)
    • the AV's 60 m, 10 m/s and 0 give \(b_{0} = 60\), \(b_{1} = 10\), \(b_{2} = 0\)
    • the same for the stop's \(c_{0}\), \(c_{1}\), \(c_{2}\)
  2. End, keep a speed, \(T = 4\):
    • \(10 + 3b_3T^2 + 4b_4T^3 = 6\)
    • \(6b_3T + 12b_4T^2 = 0\), so \(b_3 = -2T\,b_4\)
    • in the first: \(10 - 2b_4T^3 = 6\), so \(b_{4} = 2 / 4^{3} = 0.03125\)
    • \(b_{3} = -2 \times 4 \times 0.03125 = -0.25\)
  3. End, stop, \(T = 10\):
    • three equations in \(c_{3}\), \(c_{4}\), \(c_{5}\), solved as for \(d(t)\)
    • \(c_{3} = -0.0985\), \(c_{4} = 0.004775\), \(c_{5} = 0.000009\)
